title: About page
summary: A company About page composed from the marketing header + hero, a team grid, a content/blog row, a contact section, and the marketing footer.
brief: Assemble a credibility-first About page: marketing-header for site nav, a marketing-hero introducing the company, a marketing-team grid for the people, marketing-content for recent writing or press, a marketing-contact section for getting in touch, and the marketing-footer. All sections are presentational and read from the same theme.

sections.intent: Top nav with brand, links, and a primary CTA.
Introduce the company and its mission.
Optional 'by the numbers' band for scale.
Recent writing, press, or case studies.
Site navigation, policies, and social links.

layout: Stack the sections vertically in declared order inside a single page wrapper. Header first, footer last; everything between scrolls. Drop the optional stats band when there are no real numbers to share. Each section installs as its own file — import a block from `@/components/ui/<section.block>` (e.g. `import { MarketingTeam } from "@/components/ui/marketing-team"`).

checklist.check: [MarketingHeader] Avoid: Passing more than ~5 links — the inline row gets crowded; group secondary items under the CTA or a footer.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Putting raw tags in actions instead of , losing button styling.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Forgetting the logo links to '/' — wrap the logo node in an anchor.

[MarketingHeader] A11y: The mobile toggle is a <button> with aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at the panel and an aria-label that flips between 'Open menu' / 'Close menu'. Links are real anchors, keyboard-focusable, with visible focus rings.
[MarketingHero] Avoid: Passing a long paragraph as the title — keep the title to one line; move detail into description.
[MarketingHero] Avoid: Putting raw tags in actions instead of , which loses the button styling and focus ring.
[MarketingHero] Avoid: Using layout='split' with no media — it leaves an empty column; drop to 'centered'.
[MarketingHero] Avoid: Hard-coding colors via className instead of relying on the semantic tokens, which breaks theme switching.

[MarketingHero] A11y: Renders a single <h1> for the page — don't place another <h1> elsewhere. Decorative media should carry an empty alt or aria-hidden. CTA focus rings come from the Button primitive.
[MarketingTeam] Avoid: Mixing avatar sizes — pick one size class (size-16, size-20) and apply consistently.
[MarketingTeam] Avoid: Putting links to every social network — pick 1–2 most relevant (LinkedIn / GitHub for tech, Twitter / IG for consumer).
[MarketingTeam] Avoid: Long bios — keep to 1–2 lines per member or the grid gets ragged.

[MarketingTeam] A11y: Each card title renders as <h3> under the section <h2>. Decorative avatars use alt="" since the name is in adjacent text. Social-link icons must carry an accessible name (aria-label or sr-only text).
[MarketingStats] Avoid: Padding labels with the metric type (e.g. 'Active users (count)') — the value carries the meaning, the label stays short.
[MarketingStats] Avoid: Stuffing 5+ tiles into 'three' columns — use 'four' or split into two sections.
[MarketingStats] Avoid: Using app-stats-style change deltas — marketing-stats is for static milestones, not trending metrics.

[MarketingStats] A11y: Renders a <dl> with each tile as a <dt>/<dd> pair, so screen readers parse 'label / value' associations. The value uses 'order-first' on flex to render visually above the label while keeping the semantic dt→dd order.
[MarketingContent] Avoid: Omitting alt on preview images, so the index isn't navigable by screen reader.
[MarketingContent] Avoid: Putting the meta as part of the title — keep it as a separate line so search results and feeds parse the title cleanly.
[MarketingContent] Avoid: Mixing aspect ratios — the card uses 16/10; supply consistently cropped previews.

[MarketingContent] A11y: When href is set, the whole card is a single anchor with an accessible name from the title (and excerpt becomes adjacent text). When unset, the card renders as <article>. Images need alt text describing the preview.
[MarketingContact] Avoid: Inputs without <Label htmlFor> — the block is layout; pairing labels is the form's job.
[MarketingContact] Avoid: Hard-coding mailto:/tel: in details copy without making them links — visitors expect to click.
[MarketingContact] Avoid: Submitting via a button's onClick instead of <form onSubmit> — breaks keyboard Enter.

[MarketingContact] A11y: Section title is <h2>. Details and form columns are siblings, so screen readers reach details first in source order — put the most important channel first. Form labels and submit handling are your responsibility.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: One column with 20 links instead of a few grouped columns — group by topic.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Omitting the copyright line, which most footers are expected to carry.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Putting social icons with no accessible label — wrap each in a link with an aria-label or sr-only text.

[MarketingFooter] A11y: Each column title renders as an <h3>. Links are real anchors with visible hover/focus states. Social icon links need an accessible name (aria-label or sr-only text) since the icon alone isn't announced.
